init.title: MagentaCLOUD backups
init.description: Offer MagentaCLOUD as a backup location. Select it separately in backup settings and enable encryption. Files are stored in HomeAssistant-MagentaCloud. Disabling this option does not delete cloud files.

user.title: Connect to MagentaCLOUD
user.description: Create a WebDAV session under MagentaCLOUD > Settings > Devices and sessions and enter those credentials here. Backup opt-in only offers a location: select MagentaCLOUD separately in Home Assistant backup settings and enable encryption. It does not start uploads.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect MagentaCLOUD
reauth_confirm.description: Create a new WebDAV session and enter its password.

error.invalid_url: Use an HTTPS WebDAV URL without embedded credentials, query or fragment.
error.forbidden: WebDAV access is forbidden. Check the session permissions.
error.temporarily_unavailable: MagentaCLOUD is temporarily unavailable or is limiting requests. Try again later.
error.invalid_auth: The email address or WebDAV session password is invalid.
error.quota_unavailable: MagentaCLOUD did not return storage quota information.

abort.already_configured: This MagentaCLOUD account is already configured.
